title: The Function Wrapped Column
subtitle: A harmless date conversion defeats the index

brief.narrative: A report uses DATE(created_at) = :day on a 90-million-row table. The function is evaluated for every row and the normal created_at index cannot seek the range.
symptoms: Query Planner metrics diverge from the service-level symptom
The problem reproduces only under the triggering workload
Logs contain enough evidence to distinguish cause from consequence
brief.objective: Identify the root cause, select a production-safe fix, and explain the trade-off.

rootCause.question: Which root cause explains all of the evidence?

options.text: Applying a function to the indexed column made the predicate non-sargable.
options.feedback: Correct. Sargable predicates let the planner navigate an index. Compare plans and preserve timezone semantics when rewriting date ranges.

options.text: The query does not use the leftmost prefix of the composite B-tree index.
options.feedback: This choice does not explain the complete evidence or leaves the underlying correctness/reliability problem intact.

options.text: ORM lazy loading produced an N+1 query pattern.
options.feedback: This choice does not explain the complete evidence or leaves the underlying correctness/reliability problem intact.

options.text: Transactions hold pooled connections across unrelated network I/O.
options.feedback: This choice does not explain the complete evidence or leaves the underlying correctness/reliability problem intact.

fix.question: Which fix is safest for production?

options.text: Design an index whose leading columns match equality predicates, then range/order predicates; verify with EXPLAIN ANALYZE instead of guessing.
options.feedback: This choice does not explain the complete evidence or leaves the underlying correctness/reliability problem intact.

options.text: Fetch related rows in a bounded join/batch, select only required fields, and verify query count in tests or tracing.
options.feedback: This choice does not explain the complete evidence or leaves the underlying correctness/reliability problem intact.

options.text: Keep transactions short, release connections before external calls, set pool/statement timeouts, and size the pool against database capacity.
